limitations: No independent licensed match video was available. This is a NO-GO blocker.
Identity, OCR, tracking, and production integration were not tested.

manual_annotations.completeness: complete for the 20 visible players; no defensible semantic pitch-point set

pitch_mapping.automatic_error_status: No independent semantic pitch-landmark labels are available, so absolute image-to-pitch error is not measurable from this sample.
pitch_mapping.coordinate_convention: image origin is top-left; x increases right and y increases down

checks: reject a mirrored or non-convex pitch
hold out at least two landmarks and require median error <= 1.0 m and p95 <= 2.0 m
manual_fallback.observation: This frame does not expose four unambiguous named pitch intersections. A manual transform could not be tested without inventing correspondences.
manual_fallback.required_input: at least four non-collinear user-selected landmarks with known canonical identities; six or more are preferred so landmarks can be held out

model_internal_consistency.method: RANSAC homography fit against the model's own >=0.5-confidence keypoints; this is not ground-truth mapping accuracy

pitch_mapping.normalized_pitch: [pitch_length_cm / 12000, pitch_width_cm / 7000], origin at the upper-left corner of the canonical Roboflow Sports pitch

player_detection.caveat: All four cases come from one still image. Derivative results are correlated and are not dataset-level accuracy.
player_detection.match_rule: predicted bottom-center within 20 image pixels of a hand-labeled visible-player foot point; classes 1 goalkeeper and 2 player only

team_grouping.method: The upstream SigLIP, UMAP, and KMeans classifier was not run because its extra model artifacts were not pinned or licensed for this evaluation. Hand labels are ground truth only, not a substitute result.

pitch.license: Ultralytics YOLOv8 checkpoint metadata says AGPL-3.0

player.license: Ultralytics YOLOv8 checkpoint metadata says AGPL-3.0

sample_scope: one CC BY-SA 2.0 fixture plus local partial-pitch, occlusion, and poor-quality derivatives; no independent licensed video
